_schema._about: Every footer string and href (CONTRACT §3). Mirrors Lance's footer one-to-one: headline row with the primary pill, a hairline, the big lockup left, six link columns right, the small HQ line drawing bottom-left over the copyright, a badge bottom-right. Hrefs match nav.json (canonical slugs).
_schema.headline: string. 42px display (Lance: 'Bring collaborative AI to your hotel.' — 6 words).
_schema.cta: {label, href}. Same primary pill as the nav.
_schema.columns: array[6] in order. {heading, href (heading link; null = plain label), items: [{label, href}]}. Services (9) · Solutions (6 by goal) · By brand (3) · Platform (4) · Company (3) · Legal (2).
_schema.drawing: {alt}. The small HQ line drawing (src/drawing/hq.svg rendered small, as Lance's footer-buildings.png). Decorative in Lance (alt=''); ours carries alt text because CONTRACT §13 wants every image described.
_schema.copyright: string, and copyrightLines[2] for Lance's two-line break.
_schema.badge: {text, sealAlt}. Replaces Lance's 'Aligned with ISO 27001' with our own line-drawn seal — not a certification.
